main.title: Stocks, gold and silver fall after blockbuster Anthropic IPO
main.summary: Anthropic shares rose 17% on their Nasdaq debut, but the record IPO failed to halt a Wall Street sell-off. Asian stocks followed US markets lower on Friday, while gold and silver fell as investors braced for a US rate rise.

related.title: Taiwan Stock Benchmark Plunges 7%, Set for Worst Week Since 1991
related.summary: Taiwan’s tech-heavy stock market witnessed another selloff on Friday as the global artificial intelligence trade came under further strain, putting the island’s benchmark on course for its worst week since 1991.

065229de85.topic: IPO record Anthropic e crollo globale dei titoli AI
065229de85.reason: L'IPO record di Anthropic, salita del 17% al debutto, non ha fermato le vendite sui titoli AI. Il crollo è passato dal Nasdaq all'Asia: Taiwan -7%, SoftBank -16%, Hong Kong -20% dal massimo del 2026. Scendono anche oro e rame, mentre la Fed fa capire che i tassi saliranno ancora. Ne parlano molte testate e la cosa tocca da vicino i risparmi e i mercati europei.
